responsibility: Declares the high-level parser-to-codegen interface for the COBOL front end. It exposes the large family of parser_* entry points used by parse.y and related helpers to emit GENERIC for statements, arithmetic, files, calls, exceptions, intrinsics, program structure, sorting/merging, string handling, and runtime metadata, making it the public semantic/code-generation API layered above the lower-level gengen/genutil helpers.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public parser_* interface that parse.y and helpers call into; unlike genapi.cc, it provides only the API surface and shared enums/macros for that semantic/code-generation layer, not the lowering implementations.
